intent.raw: create a deep research sub agent strategy, to get papers that make sense with jus brasil ai products, they said they have unique challenges with NLP, i want to prepare for the call, what could i read of literature, what papers we can find in arxiv?
intent.objective: Plan a governed multi-agent deep-research investigation that produces an arXiv-backed reading list on legal NLP relevant to Jusbrasil's AI products (Jus IA: smart summaries, main theses extraction, similar jurisprudence retrieval, legal research assistant, audio transcription), organized as call-preparation talking points about Brazilian legal NLP challenges.
intent.operator_sentence: Use a deep-research fanout over six legal-NLP literature lanes, then synthesize a product-mapped reading list and call-prep brief.

route_menu.context_hint: The target is external literature, not repository code, so web-capable research subagents are the natural executor.

items.label: Deep-research literature fanout
items.description: Run parallel research lanes over Portuguese legal language models, legal retrieval/RAG, summarization, NER/structure, evaluation/hallucination, and product crosswalk.

items.label: Single-pass survey
items.description: One agent does a broad survey without lane specialization; cheaper but shallower coverage of arXiv.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The intent spans six weakly-coupled literature areas that each need independent web/arXiv search depth; one context cannot hold all lanes without shallow coverage.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Role-bound sibling research agents let each lane sweep arXiv and adjacent venues independently (different query vocabularies per lane), while a parent synthesis step joins receipts into one product-mapped reading list. This matches the fanout shape: lanes do not depend on each other's intermediate results.
context: Jusbrasil's Jus IA Academy site confirms product features: smart summaries, main theses organization, similar jurisprudence retrieval, prompt library, audio transcription.

Jusbrasil engineers claim 'unique challenges with NLP', most plausibly: Brazilian Portuguese legal register, very long judicial documents, OCR-noisy filings, citation/jurisprudence graph scale, and hallucination risk in legal answers.
The operator needs the reading list before a scheduled call, so lanes must return concrete arXiv IDs, not vague pointers.

roles.owns: Lane receipt: legal-retrieval-rag paper set with arXiv IDs and relevance notes.

roles.purpose: Find papers on judicial decision summarization, main-thesis/holding extraction, rhetorical role labeling, and long-document modeling.
roles.owns: Lane receipt: legal-summarization paper set with arXiv IDs and relevance notes.

roles.purpose: Find papers on legal AI evaluation benchmarks, hallucination measurement in legal LLMs, faithfulness, and Brazilian/Portuguese legal benchmarks.
roles.owns: Lane receipt: evaluation-hallucination paper set with arXiv IDs and relevance notes.

roles.purpose: Find papers and recent systems pointing at plausible next products for Jusbrasil: judicial outcome prediction, contract review, petition/document drafting, agentic legal workflows, multimodal (audio/hearing) processing, negotiation and settlement analytics.
roles.owns: Lane receipt: next-product-opportunities paper set with arXiv IDs, relevance notes, and a candidate-product sketch per cluster.

roles.purpose: Map joined lane findings to specific Jus IA product features and draft call-ready talking points about Jusbrasil's stated NLP challenges.
roles.owns: Crosswalk receipt: feature-to-paper mapping and candidate call questions.

subagent_strategy.authorization_record: Operator approved on 2026-06-10 via AskUserQuestion with modification: add one lane exploring possible next products (L7-next-product-opportunities).
subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run 6 parallel deep-research lanes (web + arXiv search) plus parent synthesis to produce an arXiv-backed legal-NLP reading list mapped to Jusbrasil's Jus IA products and next-product opportunities? Output written to research/jusbrasil-call/READING-LIST.md.
receipt_requirements: Each lane returns 5-10 papers with arXiv ID or DOI, title, year, venue when known.
Each paper carries a one-paragraph relevance note tied to a Jus IA feature or stated NLP challenge.
Each lane separately lists Brazilian/Portuguese-specific work versus general legal-NLP work.
Each lane names residue: queries that returned nothing useful and open questions for the call.

subagent_lifecycle.note: Role L6-product-crosswalk was executed by the parent (join_policy parent_synthesis), not spawned, so it has no agent entry. All six spawned lane agents joined with receipts and closed.

steps.name: Recover Jusbrasil product context and frame the research questions
stop_conditions: Flag if product-feature claims cannot be grounded in the Jus IA Academy site or operator-provided context.

steps.name: Run parallel legal-NLP literature research lanes

capability_metadata.note: deep-research is a session-level research harness skill, external to the Arcanum canonical capability registry; it executes web/arXiv fan-out searches with adversarial verification.

convergence_criteria: Every lane returns its receipt with arXiv IDs or DOIs for each cited paper.
Every lane separates Brazilian/Portuguese-specific findings from general legal-NLP findings.
Every lane includes at least two papers from 2024 or later.
stop_conditions: Block synthesis if any lane returns papers without resolvable identifiers.
Flag lanes that cannot find Brazilian/Portuguese-specific work and record the gap as residue.

steps.name: Synthesize product-mapped reading list and call-prep brief
convergence_criteria: Reading list is organized by Jus IA product feature, then by lane.
A prioritized 'read first' shortlist of at most 8 papers exists for limited prep time.
Open questions for the call are listed with the papers that motivated them.
Residue (gaps, dead-end queries, unverified claims) is preserved in a ledger section.

steps.name: Hand off call-prep brief to the operator

gates.condition: The literature fanout must not spawn subagents until the operator approves the subagent strategy permission prompt.
Every cited paper must carry a resolvable arXiv ID, DOI, or stable link; unresolvable citations are dropped or flagged as residue.
The synthesized reading list must mix foundational work with at least one-third papers from 2024-2026.
Call-prep artifacts stay in the private parent repository and are never written into the public arcanum submodule.
Research outputs are call-prep candidates only; they must not promote inventory, ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell knowledge.

boundaries.contract: Research lanes receive the product-context frame and lane charter only; they return structured receipts and must not write repository artifacts outside research/jusbrasil-call/.
All call-prep artifacts are written under research/jusbrasil-call/ in the private parent repository, never under the public arcanum submodule.

promotion_guardrails: Do not promote literature findings into Arcanum inventory, ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell artifacts.
Do not write call-prep or client-specific content into the public arcanum submodule.
Treat paper relevance claims as candidates until the operator reviews them before the call.
